inv.desc_en: COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR RENT. Vía Universitas Street. Unbeatable location. Premises with 237 m² built and 192 m² usable. Large facade and large storefront facing the avenue. Ideal for capturing customer attention. For only €1,000 per month. Spacious and bright. Large entrance door and large glass windows creating an open and attractive environment. It has bathrooms. Utility room with a sink and three rooms. A very versatile space for multiple businesses. Perfect for: Clothing store, beauty center, offices, professional practice, dental clinic, academy, etc. , and any other project that requires a space with excellent visibility. Established and dynamic area. Located on a street with high commercial and pedestrian activity. Opportunity for entrepreneurs or companies. Ideal for those looking to stand out in a lively area with potential. A space designed to make any business idea a reality. Interested? Do not hesitate to contact us. We are happy to answer your questions and organize a visit [IW].
